entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the respondents are illegally formed a buddy drain channel by changing the approved alignment by encroaching property of the petitioner in an extent of Ac.0.71 cents of Kakupalli Bit2 Madaraju Gudu, SPSR Nellore District.
She submits that the alignment for forming buddy drain channel was approved by the competent authority and it cannot be changed without prior approval.
The respondents are at liberty to follow due procedure and call objections from the respective authorities for the change of approved alignment.

But, the case in hand is without initiating the procedure for acquisition as required, the respondents are trying to encroach over the property of the petitioner without following due procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Act 30 of 2013.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Act 30 of 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Hence the Writ Petition.

4. On the other hand, learned Government Pleader placed written instructions dated 06.03.2024,
wherein it is stated as under:
"And in the 2nd reach it is observed that the land is under the enjoyment of the Sri M.
Penchala Naidu for an extent of 0.61 acres which may also needs to be excavated to bring the drain into the original approved alignment.
In view of the above an estimate is prepared for the work "Restoration of Buddy medium drain in between km 13,300 to Km 13,900 duly shifting of drain from private lands to adjoining available Government Land near Madaraju Guduru village in Nellore Rural Mandal of SPSR Nellore District" for rupees 9.90 Lakh to restore the drain to the original alignment as requested by the petitioner and submitted to the higher authorities for sanction.
After getting necessary approval from higher authorities the work will be taken up."

5. In view of the above stated facts, the respondents have not changed any approved alignment for forming buddy drain channel as alleged by the petitioner and further stated they are not informed the objections, if any, in respect of peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner.

sentences.text: In view of the submissions and written instructions issued by the respondent No.5 that the claim of the petitioner is redressed by the respondents.

7. Having regard to the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for the respondents and on perusal of the written instructions of the respondent No.5 dated 06.03.2024, the respondents are not interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner as alleged in the writ petition and not forming the buddy drain channel as per the approval land alignment.
8. Therefore, no further orders are necessary in the present writ petition.
Further, the respondents are directed not to interfere with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner's land.
9. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
